messages:
jordan: quick thought — can we trial a 'micro-followup' for postmortems? super lightweight: owner, ETA, blockers. keeps momentum after incidents :thinking_face:
maria: curious how this differs from the 72h draft? we already have that cadence
jordan: 72h stays for full postmortems. micro-followup = same-day action to avoid ownership drift. template is 30items + recurrence flag
sam: yes please. a lot of recurring issues stall until the 72h and then never make progress
lee: who should initiate? IC or the person writing the PM?
jordan: IC should kick it off in-channel before handing off; then assign to postmortem owner or squad lead for tracking. keeps IC rotation simple
maria: can you paste a tiny timeline snippet we can paste into threads and PMs?
jordan: sure, pasteable block:
```
MICRO-FOLLOWUP (quick)
- Owner: @owner
- Goal: short description of what will be fixed
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD or hh:mm UTC
- Blockers: (brief)
- Recurrence risk: low/medium/high
- Next check-in: +48h
```
praveen: ops note  we should add an inc-bot 48h ping if no update. otherwise small tasks slip
inc-bot: Suggestion logged. inc-bot can ping @owner at +48h if status remains "open". (requires eng-sre opt-in)
maria: also make a stakeholder comms one-liner template: status + ETA + impact statement
sam: propose treadmill: log micro-followups in remediation board as card type "micro" so they get short-lived tracking, not lost in backlog
lee: rotation rule: IC must @assign owner before end of shift. if owner not available, IC assigns squad lead as interim owner
praveen: I'll prototype an inc-bot workflow and a small card type in the remediation board. ETA 3 days
jordan: next steps: 1) KB update with template (maria) 2) postmortem checklist item for micro-followups (sam) 3) inc-bot ping + board card prototype (praveen) 4) pilot on next IC rotation (lee)
maria: taking KB edit, will add examples and pasteable snippets by tomorrow EOD
sam: adding checklist item now, will open PR for review
praveen: opening inc-bot ticket, linking to this thread. aiming to test in staging before pilot
lee: I'll run pilot during Wednesday IC, will report back with sample threads and board cards
jordan: thanks all. small experiment but should reduce ownership lag and surface recurrence patterns faster :rocket:
